documentation.content:
The uptime check for https://guianegocios.net/ has failed from multiple regions.

What to check, in order:
1. Open https://guianegocios.net/ yourself. If it loads, the check may be a false alarm - review the check in Monitoring > Uptime checks.
2. https://status.firebase.google.com/ for a Hosting or Cloud Functions incident.
3. Check the last hosting deploy: `gh run list --limit 5` then `gh run view <id>`. If the newest run is bad, roll back with `firebase hosting:rollback --project guianegocios-prod`.
4. If the cert, DNS or domain mapping has lapsed, check Hosting > Domains in the Firebase console.

Rollback procedures are in docs/07-backup-monitoring-rollback.md.
